clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Nominates Sugiono and Amran Sulaiman as VP Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto proposed Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman as vice presidential candidates to the MPR.
The nominations aim to fill the vacant vice presidency following the departure of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Nominates Sugiono and Amran for Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto formally nominated Sugiono and Amran as candidates to replace the former vice president.
The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) rescheduled the plenary session for the vice presidential election to December 11, 2026.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Submits Two Wapres Candidates to MPR
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially submitted two candidates for the vice president position to the MPR.
The names were proposed as replacements for Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: Search and Rescue Teams Recover 26 Bodies at PT Fonusa Agung Mulia
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have recovered a total of 26 bodies from the factory site in Cikande, Serang.
The Ministry of Manpower has deployed safety experts to investigate potential violations of workplace health and safety standards.

clusters.headline: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin Proposes Three Vice President Roles
aiSummaryBullets: Sultan Najamudin, Chair of the DPD RI, proposed the potential addition of three vice president positions to support national governance.
The official stated the concept is not intended for the immediate term but is presented as a long-term idea for consideration.

clusters.headline: Jakarta And Regional Officials Respond To Multiple Landslide Events
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta authorities are planning to build a permanent retaining wall in Pejaten Timur following recurring landslides triggered by heavy rain.
Emergency response teams have been deployed to South Jakarta to assist displaced residents and manage the impact of recent soil instability.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Political Scrutiny Follows Vice President Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: Media coverage is currently focused on the retirement entitlements and security provisions applicable to Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Political parties and local officials are responding to the vacancy, with some organizations reaffirming their support for the current administration.

clusters.headline: Bahlil Lahadalia Denies Mining Permits For Ujung Kulon National Park
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister Bahlil Lahadalia confirmed no mining business licenses exist for Ujung Kulon National Park.
The Ministry of Forestry stated that mining permits will not be issued for the protected area serving as the Javan rhino's habitat.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Nationals Recruited As Russian Mercenaries Intercepted
aiSummaryBullets: Two Indonesian citizens attempting to join Russian military operations were stopped at an airport in Surabaya.
The individuals allegedly claimed to be traveling for vacation before their recruitment was discovered.

clusters.headline: Tito Karnavian and Bima Arya Push for Regional Economic Integration
aiSummaryBullets: Minister Tito Karnavian is prioritizing the harmonization of over 17,000 regional regulations to improve administrative efficiency.
Bima Arya is encouraging local governments to develop specific regional economic ecosystems by mapping potential sectors and resources.

clusters.headline: Kapolda Metro Jaya Dadang Hartanto Rombak Jabatan Dan Ungkap Scam
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya mencatat 4.097 kasus penipuan daring antara 2025 hingga November 2026 dengan total kerugian mencapai Rp1,49 triliun.
Komjen Dadang Hartanto memaparkan berbagai modus operandi penipuan daring, termasuk skema percintaan atau love scam dan penggunaan nama instansi.

clusters.headline: Surabaya, Tangerang And Banyuwangi Receive Regional 2026 Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Surabaya was honored with two national awards at the 2026 Smart City Forum for digital service innovations.
Tangerang Regency received recognition for its implementation of green industry practices.

clusters.headline: Erin Mantan Istri Andre Taulany Jadi Tersangka Kasus Penganiayaan
aiSummaryBullets: Erin Wartia ditetapkan sebagai tersangka atas laporan dugaan penganiayaan terhadap mantan asisten rumah tangganya, Herawati.
Pihak Erin Wartia menyatakan terbuka terhadap peluang perdamaian melalui mekanisme restorative justice.

clusters.headline: DKPP Holds Ethics Hearing On Gibran Rakabuming Raka Candidacy Case
aiSummaryBullets: The DKPP is presiding over a hearing regarding alleged ethics violations by the KPU during the 2024 presidential candidacy process.
Complainants, including Denny Indrayana, have questioned the KPU's handling of document verification and regulatory adjustments related to the candidacy.

clusters.headline: Government Officials Inspect Flood Mitigation Efforts In Sumatra
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials visited Subulussalam, Aceh, to observe the impact of recent recurring floods.
The disaster task force is prioritizing river normalization efforts and infrastructure projects like Sabo dams.

clusters.headline: Iran Drone And Missile Strikes Hit Civilian Sites In Bahrain
aiSummaryBullets: Iranian-led strikes impacted civilian industrial facilities in Bahrain, causing injuries to at least two individuals.
The casualties have been identified as citizens of Bahrain and Pakistan.

clusters.headline: Daftar Pemain Timnas Indonesia yang Diprediksi Tampil di SEA Games 2027, John Herdman Sudah Sebut…
aiSummaryBullets: VIVA reports: Daftar Pemain Timnas Indonesia yang Diprediksi Tampil di SEA Games 2027, John Herdman Sudah Sebut Dua Nama
Okezone reports: Panggil Arlyansyah Abdulmanan dan Zanadin Fariz ke Timnas Indonesia, John Herdman Bangga Lihat Progres Keduanya

clusters.headline: KPK To Imprison Three Former Customs Officials In Graft Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) is preparing to execute prison sentences for three former officials.
The officials, identified as Rizal, Sisprian, and Orlando, received sentences of nine, seven, and six years respectively.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Questions Witnesses in Alleged Kupang Regent Rape Case
aiSummaryBullets: Investigators from the NTT Regional Police have questioned over a dozen witnesses regarding allegations of sexual violence involving Kupang Regent Yosef Lede.
The Ministry of Home Affairs has formally granted permission for authorities to proceed with the examination and potential detention of the official.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Pass Asset Recovery Bill Into National Law
aiSummaryBullets: The Asset Recovery Law has been formally enacted by the Indonesian government.
Prosecutors are preparing for in absentia trials to pursue assets linked to major corruption fugitives.
